headline: Fotofestiwal: the international festival of photography in Łódź – in pictures
context: Now in it’s 25th year, the Polish city’s Fotofestiwal opens on 18 June with a series of exhibitions reflecting on the concept of a collective experience rather than a binary world of “us” and “them” Continue reading...
